primitives.name: User Entitlement Resolver
primitives.verbatim_quote: The single DB-backed source of truth for a user's tier.
primitives.assumptions: Database is authoritative; all errors except P1001 result in rethrow.
primitives.breakdown_regime: When DB unreachable (P1001), defaults to FREE tier.

layer2.mapping: Resolves user tier from persistent storage into access policy kernel.
layer2.telemetry: Database query success/failure and returned tier

primitives.name: API Gate Evaluator
primitives.verbatim_quote: It is `gateApi`'s `evaluateGate` (`apps/web/lib/api-entitlement.ts`) that wraps the `getUserEntitlements` call in its own try/catch and falls back to `FREE` on *any* thrown error — so callers that go through `gateApi`/`requirePremiumApi`/`requireFantasyApi` fail closed to `FREE` overall, but `getUserEntitlements` called directly does not.
primitives.assumptions: All API gates wrap `getUserEntitlements` with try/catch.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Any exception triggers fallback to FREE tier.

layer2.mapping: Maps error-prone entitlement resolution to deterministic access control logic.
layer2.telemetry: Exception count, fallback frequency, gate pass/fail ratio

primitives.name: Premium API Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: **`requirePremiumApi()`** — pre-built `gateApi` call for the PRO/ELITE floor (`isPremium = tier === "PRO" || tier === "ELITE"`).
primitives.assumptions: Only PRO and ELITE tiers pass; FANTASY is excluded.
primitives.breakdown_regime: Returns 403 if tier < PRO, 401 if unauthenticated.

layer2.mapping: Enforces premium tier membership via predicate on resolved entitlements.
layer2.telemetry: Access denial counts, tier distribution among requests

primitives.name: Rate-Limited Premium Gate
primitives.verbatim_quote: **`requirePremiumApiRateLimited(bucketId: string)`** — same PRO/ELITE floor as `requirePremiumApi`, plus a per-user rate limit applied *after* the entitlement check, so a 429 never masks the paywall.

layer2.mapping: Combines entitlement validation with rate-limiting logic to prevent abuse while preserving access control.
layer2.telemetry: Rate limit hits, request volume, access denial types

reasoning_traces.think:
The system implements a layered access control model where entitlements are resolved server-side from a single database-backed source. This ensures that frontend-only UI elements cannot bypass security. The `gateApi` abstraction encapsulates error handling and fallback behavior, making it resilient to transient DB failures by defaulting to FREE tier. The `requirePremiumApi` primitive applies a binary predicate to enforce tier floors (PRO/ELITE), while `requirePremiumApiRateLimited` adds a rate-limiting layer that does not mask paywall denials. These primitives form a closed-loop system where each API route must validate entitlements before accessing data, preventing unauthorized access even if UI components are bypassed. The design avoids client-side enforcement and instead relies on deterministic server-side checks. Failure modes are well-defined: P1001 errors trigger fallback, other errors propagate up unless caught by gate wrappers. The system supports both direct entitlement queries and gated API access patterns, maintaining consistency across layers.
